prompt:
Find what the Node.js project officially says about the lifecycle of its LTS releases (how long Active LTS and Maintenance LTS last). Cite the official page and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official Node.js release page, here is the information on the LTS release lifecycle.

The Node.js project maintains a detailed schedule for its Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Each major release line goes through three distinct phases: Current, Active LTS, and Maintenance LTS. The official policy states that Active LTS lasts for 12 months, followed by Maintenance LTS for an additional 18 months, resulting in a total support lifespan of 30 months from its LTS designation.

SOURCE: https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases | QUOTE: "Production applications should only use Active LTS or Maintenance LTS releases." | CLAIM: Official releases for production are Active LTS and Maintenance LTS.

SOURCE: https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases | QUOTE: "Active LTS - Will receive code fixes, security updates and likely performance improvements for a period of 12 months from the date it enters LTS." | CLAIM: The Active LTS phase lasts for 12 months.

SOURCE: https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases | QUOTE: "Maintenance LTS - Will only receive critical bug fixes and security updates for a further 18 months from the end of the Active LTS window." | CLAIM: The Maintenance LTS phase lasts for 18 months after Active LTS ends.

SOURCE: https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases | QUOTE: "This gives each major release line a total lifespan of 30 months from the date it enters LTS." | CLAIM: The total LTS support period (Active + Maintenance) is 30 months.
